name: Sungkyunkwan University Graduate School of Business (SKK GSB)

program.note: Full-Time MBA in English: 18 months (or 12 months fast track), starts August, graduation February, 45 credits. Cohort size not published on the page.

tuition_total.note: 1st semester (Fall) 15,100,000 + 2nd (Spring & Summer) 22,800,000 + 3rd (Fall) 15,100,000. 12-month track billed the same three semesters. Subject to change each year. Study Abroad / Dual Degree semesters billed differently (2018 tables).

mandatory_fees_total.note: Entrance fee KRW 1,300,000. Student/alumni union fees and overseas field trip fees also excluded from tuition, amounts not published.

living_budget_total.note: No official living budget found on the SKK GSB site.

examples.name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS, NIIED)
examples.value: full tuition + living expenses, airfare, language course

scholarship.note: Number of scholars not specified; covers tuition in Korea only (not SAP/DDP).

base_salary.note: School shows '147,152 Average Salary - three years after graduation, PPP equivalent' and '100% Salary Increase' (image https://biz.skku.edu/_res/en/img/sub/img_career02.gif). This is the FT alumni-survey salary 3 years out (printed with a stray '%'), not a graduating-class base salary, so it is not used as base_salary. Cohort/year of the 93% not stated on the image.

employment.note: Industry split read from the image https://biz.skku.edu/_res/en/img/sub/img_career05.gif ('Industry Sectors, Class of 2025'; image alt text says Class of 2020, chart itself says 2025). No salary by industry, no geography, no employer list published.

profile.note: Read from images on the page (fxe_img_meet_ex01/04.jpg). Text says 'approximately 50% of our students are international'. Pre-MBA position: Staff 34%, Manager 26%, Deputy GM 13%, GM 11%, VP-Director 8%, Others 8%.

notes: FT Global MBA 2026 rank not found; school rankings image (img-mab-ranking-2025.png, alt 'MBA in World 65 FT') refers to 2025. Career ranking image cites FT 2023-2025 sub-ranks (value for money 27th 2023, sector diversity 14th 2025). No graduating salary: exclude from salary-based ROI ranking.
